items.quote: This Policy and the associated Procedure apply to Members of the VIU Community and to risks, threats and incidents of Sexualized Violence and Misconduct that affect the working, learning, or living environment at VIU.
items.reason: The policy is a stand-alone sexualized violence policy with its own reporting and investigation procedures.

items.quote: The Act requires BC post-secondary institutions to establish, implement, and make publicly available a policy, with associated procedures, that addresses Sexual Misconduct, its prevention, and responses to sexual misconduct.
items.reason: The policy commits to being publicly available in compliance with the Act.

items.quote: A Report may be made only to VIU’s Diversity, Equity and Human Rights Office directly or to a Third Party Reporting Agency with a request that the Third Party Reporting Agency submit the Report to VIU’s Diversity, Equity and Human Rights Office.
items.reason: The policy sets out clear, concrete steps and contact information for making a report.
The policy does not address restrictions on asking about the complainant's past sexual history.

items.quote: Have reasonable actions taken to prevent further unwanted contact with the other person involved in the incident;
items.reason: The policy provides a right to have reasonable actions taken to prevent unwanted contact, which is discretionary.

items.quote: This does not prevent such individuals from disclosing information about themselves or information that they obtained outside of the investigation.
items.reason: The policy explicitly states that participants are not prevented from disclosing information about their own experiences.

items.quote: Personal agency means that an individual is the decision-maker about making a Disclosure and/or Report, pursuing external processes such as criminal or civil action and accessing support services, including Accommodations.
items.reason: The policy guarantees the complainant's right to choose between institutional and external processes.
The policy does not mention amnesty for drug or alcohol use when reporting.

items.quote: VIU will respond to and address Disclosures and Reports and conduct investigations of Reports in a timely manner.
items.reason: The overall timeline is vague, and specific procedural timelines are subject to revision.

items.quote: While the University is engaged in the risk and threat assessment process, and throughout a subsequent investigation should one be undertaken, action to address the safety concerns of the Complainant, while also considering the interests of the Respondent, may be taken such as:
items.reason: Interim measures are available but described as discretionary.

items.quote: The policy applies to activities on all university campuses and properties and at any university event on or off campus, whether in person or virtual that impacts the learning, living and working environment for members of the University community.
items.reason: Off-campus activities are covered only generally, without explicit mention of co-ops or internships.

items.quote: details of disciplinary action taken as a result of a Report will be disclosed only if such information is necessary for health or safety reasons;
items.reason: Informing the complainant of disciplinary action is limited to health or safety reasons.

items.quote: VIU will compile anonymized data related to Reports and will make this data available to the public annually.
items.reason: The policy commits to publishing anonymized data related to reports annually to the public.

items.quote: VIU will review the policy every three years as per the Act.
items.reason: The policy requires review every three years, which is longer than the two-year benchmark.
The policy does not address student representation on the policy review committee.

items.quote: VIU will ensure that individuals receiving, investigating and adjudicating Reports of Sexual Misconduct have adequate training and competency to understand sexualized violence, and fundamentals of Trauma-informed practice.
items.reason: The policy requires trauma-informed training for those receiving, investigating, and adjudicating reports.

items.quote: VIU is committed to providing comprehensive and inclusive Sexual Misconduct prevention initiatives for Members of the VIU Community, including education and awareness programs, safety measures and campus communications.
items.reason: The policy commits to providing prevention education and awareness programs for the university community.
